decision_delta: Greyhound now enforces V2 task, preflight, capability, outcome, and decision semantics for non-trivial work, with a deterministic four-decision seed and an explicit first-five-run observation gate.
invalidation_conditions: Greyhound canonical instructions or hook configuration no longer enforce the reviewed V2 contract.
The synced Tenn portable guard no longer selects the target repository canonical branch or active V2 claim correctly.
One of the four stable seed artifact hashes or validated semantic predicates changes.
reopen_conditions: A materially different V2 enforcement hypothesis is proposed with changed evidence.
Review of the first five non-trivial post-pilot runs finds a false duplicate block or another enforcement defect.
Greyhound canonical source, Tenn V2 semantics, or a stable seed artifact changes.
